name: dashboard
description: Web dashboard: a local HTTP service inside the MCP process (dashboard, brain-world chat, wrap-up report HUD); port takeover and the release handshake live here too

dashboard.what: Memory system dashboard (atoms / conversation monitor / health check / tests)
dashboard.how: Served inside the MCP process; available once Claude Code has started. Port: WG_DASHBOARD_PORT env var → dashboard_port in workflow/config.json → 3848

anti_evasion_hud.what: Anti-Evasion HUD (wrap-up check report: gap fixes / evasion reports / token warnings / derived temp files)

brain_world.what: Brain world (memory cards shown as a living ecosystem)
brain_world.how: Static file with no route; open it directly in a browser (file://). The page polls http://127.0.0.1:3848/api/* by itself, so the dashboard must be running
